body.name: terminal sample budget
body.construction: Set \(e_{\star}=\min\{g_0h_0/(16n),\tau g_0/(4\sqrt n)\}\), \(b_{\star}=\min\{(2\kappa)^{-1},e_{\star}/(40\kappa^4)\}\), \(q_{\star}=64\kappa^2/b_{\star}^2\), \(t_0=n\log 9+\log(2(n+1)/\alpha)\), and \(u_{\star}=t_0+\log(16q_{\star})\). Let \(B_{\mathrm{samp}}=2^{\lceil\log_2(\max\{n,\lceil32q_{\star}u_{\star}\rceil\})\rceil}\) be the cumulative post-support cap in every environment. The observational environment uses at most \(B_0=n+B_{\mathrm{samp}}\) observations after including its disjoint \(n\)-observation support batch, every intervention environment uses at most \(B_{\mathrm{samp}}\), and the total across all environments is at most \(B_{\mathrm{tot}}=n+(n+1)B_{\mathrm{samp}}\).
